tei:div.tei:p: (tha)༄༅// 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal ba'i tshigs su bcad pa rgyal sras thogs med bzang pos mdzad pa bzhugs so// thugs rje chen po la phyag 'tshal lo// mtshan dpe'i cha shas yongs su rdzogs pa'i sku// ston ka'i zla ba 'bum phrag tshogs pa'i mdangs// rin chen bye ba'i rgyan gyis rnam bkra ba'i// thugs rje chen po khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// shes bya ma lus mkhyen pa'i bcom ldan 'das// 'gro ba kun la bu gcig lta bur brtse// lhun grub rgyun mi chad pa'i phrin las can// thugs rje chen po khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// bsod nams ye shes tshogs gnyis rab rdzogs shing*// dmigs med thugs rje bsil ba'i 'od zer gyis// 'gro ba'i nyon mongs gdung sel bcom ldan 'das// thugs rje chen po khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// sgrib gnyis bag chags bcas pa gtan spangs shing*// ji bzhin ji snyed mkhyen pa'i 'od zer gyis// 'gro ba'i ma rig mun sel bcom ldan 'das// thugs rje chen po khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// yon tan rab rdzogs sku gsum chu 'dzin las// gang la gang 'dul phrin las char phab nas// phan bde'i lo tog rgyas mdzad bcom ldan 'das// thugs rje chen po khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// tshogs gnyis rab rdzogs smon lam mthar phyin pas// mthong dang thos dang dran pa tsam gyis kyang*// las dang nyon mongs sdug bsngal zhi mdzad pa'i// thugs rje chen po khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// 'gro kun bsam pa'i bye brag legs rtogs nas// gang la gang gis 'dul ba'i skur bstan te// rang rang skad kyis dam pa'i chos bstan pa'i// thugs rje chen po khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// gdul bya'i yul rnams ma bsgribs gsal bar gzigs// 'dul ba'i thabs la ma rmongs legs par mkhyen// gdul bya 'dul ba'i dus la mi 'da' ba'i// thugs rje chen po khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// zhing rdul grangs dang mnyam pa'i skur ston cing*// nam mkha'i mtha' klas dbyangs kyis khyab par mdzad// ji bzhin ji snyed mkhyen pa'i thugs mnga' ba'i// thugs rje chen po khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// gting mtha' med pa 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho ru// sdug bsngal brgya yis gtses pa'i sems can rnams// rnam grol bde ba'i gling du 'dren mdzad pa'i// thugs rje chen po khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// las dang nyon mongs bud shing las byung ba'i// sdug bsngal me yis gdungs pa'i 'gro ba rnams// thugs rje'i char rgyun bsil bas zhi mdzad pa'i// thugs rje chen po khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// gang gis bcings nas bskal brgyar rab 'bad kyang*// 'khor ba'i btson rwar 'da' bar mi nus pa'i// bdag tu 'dzin pa'i lcags sgrog 'grol mdzad pa'i// thugs rje chen po khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// 'dod chags chu rgyun rtsad nas gcod mdzad cing*// zhe sdang me lce'i phreng ba zhi bar mdzod// gti mug mun nag thibs po sel mdzad pa'i// thugs rje chen po khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// nyon mongs rims nad ma lus zhi mdzad cing*// las kyi 'ching ba dam po gcod par mdzod// sdug bsngal chu bo che las sgrol mdzad pa'i// thugs rje chen po khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// mnar med me nang bsil ba'i chu rgyun 'bebs// yi dwags bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyis tshim mdzad cing*// dud 'gro'ang bden pa mthong la sbyor mdzad pa'i// thugs rje chen po khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// mchod dang gdod pa byed pa'i skye bo la'ang*// rjes su chags dang khong khro mi mnga' zhing*// mtshungs par tshad med thugs rjes skyong mdzad pa'i// thugs rje chen po khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// ji skad bstan bzhin legs par sgrub pa dang*// phyin ci log tu sgrub pa'i skye bo la'ang*// nam mkha' lta bur snyoms pa'i thugs rje can// thugs rje chen po khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// khro dang rjes su chags sogs mi mnga' yang*// khro ba can la khro bo'i rnam pa sogs// mthun par bstan nas khro sogs rgyun gcod pa'i// thugs rje chen po khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// zhum pa gzengs bstod khengs pa dul bar mdzad// sred ldan skyo skyed nyam thag bde mdzad sogs// sna tshogs thabs kyis 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa'i// thugs rje chen po khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// srid pa'i bde sdug rmi lam sgyu ma bzhin// snang yang bden pas stong par legs bstan nas// blang dang dor ba'i mngon zhen spong mdzad pa'i// thugs rje chen po khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// 'khor dang mya ngan 'das pa'i chos rnams kun// rang rang ngo bos stong yang dkar nag gi// rgyu 'bras bslu ba med par ston mdzad pa'i// thugs rje chen po khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// sdug bsngal mang ldan 'gro ba yal bor nas// rang gi bde ba don gnyer skye bo rnams// snying rjes gzhan gyi don la sbyor mdzad pa'i// thugs rje chen po khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// 'khor ba'i rang bzhin rang bzhin med pa'i don// ma rtogs dbang gis 'khor bar 'gro ba la// 'khor ba rang bzhin med par ston mdzad pa'i// thugs rje chen po khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// rang dang gzhan dang gnyis dang rgyu med las// ma skyes pas na chos rnams thams cad kun// gdod nas skye bamed par ston mdzad pa'i// thugs rje chen po khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// bde gshegs snying po sems kyi de bzhin nyid// spros bral gdod nas rnam dag chos kyi sku// blo bur dri ma'i sbubs nas 'byin mdzad pa'i// thugs rje chen po khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la bstod pa/

shlo ka nyi shu rtsa lnga pa 'di/ chos smra ba'i btsun pa thogs med kyis dngul chu'i chos rdzong du sbyar ba'o// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
